title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a killer China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and excellent matrix recording quality
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the performance, calling the China Cat / Rider sequence “killer” and praising the overall groovy vibe reminiscent of Europe ’72. The source is a soundboard‑matrix (sbd.mtx) derived from an early reel‑to‑reel master described as “awesome quality,” indicating a clear and well‑balanced recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both the musical performance and the tape’s audio fidelity, but only one brief review limits certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes an early generation reel‑to‑reel master of “awesome quality,” suggesting a clear, well‑balanced matrix mix with no reported issues.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
